openFailures.test: preserves a dirty draft when an external disk edit causes a conflict
openFailures.failure: Wait for document conflict state timed out after 30000 ms.
openFailures.retry: Same assertion failed on a second run; that run was interrupted after it remained active without further results. Its native test processes were cleaned up.
openFailures.attribution: This task did not change document conflict or filesystem watcher code. Whether the failure also occurs at the base commit was not verified.

notRun: real SSH connection through the native UI (real transport and native dialog have separate tests)
